card.title: A supercomputer with benches around it

body.question: The Cray-1 had a ring of benches around the outside of its C-shaped cabinet. What did the benches cover?
options: The power supplies and the cooling system
body.reveal: The benches covered the power supplies and the cooling system. The Cray-1 is perhaps best known for its unique shape, a relatively small C-shaped cabinet. The initial model, the Cray-1A, weighed 10,500 pounds (4,800 kg) including the Freon refrigeration system.

probes.question: True or false: the Cray-1 is perhaps best known for its C-shaped cabinet.
What ran in stainless steel pipes to draw heat away from the Cray-1 circuit boards?

image_brief.show: A Cray-1 supercomputer showing its C-shaped cabinet and bench ring
